consumer: The frontend inventory panel renderer reading avatar.carried_items[], asking 'what items is the avatar holding (wielded/worn/inventory) to list top-level?'
scope: The avatar's top-level carried-item containers: wielded items, worn items, and top-level inventory stacks (not nested container/pocket contents).
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items enumerates ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() and emits each item's raw type_id/name/symbol/location/charges, dumping authoritative carried-item state with no predicate or display filtering.
divergence: An item placed inside a worn backpack's pocket: it is held but not a top-level carried item, so it is correctly absent from this enumeration, confirming the surface matches the 'top-level what they are holding' scope rather than a deeper possession reach.
